page.title: Settings
page.subtitle: How Toskar should behave on this computer.

appearance.title: Appearance
appearance.description: Choose light, dark, or follow the system.

language.title: Language
language.description: The language of menus, buttons, and messages in Toskar on every computer and phone you use with it. Each device can follow its own system language.

status.machine: Machine translated, so some wording may read oddly until a person reviews it.
status.partial: Partly translated. What isn’t translated yet shows in English.

language.assistantAuto: Auto-detect: the language you write in
language.assistantHint: The language answers are written in. You can always ask for another in a message, such as “answer in English”.
language.saveFailed: The language could not be saved: {{error}}

personalization.title: Personalization
personalization.description: How answers should look, in every chat and automation. This shapes style only. What the AI may do is set under Tool permissions, and nothing here or in Memory can change it.
personalization.aboutYouPlaceholder: I'm a backend engineer in Juneau. My main project is a Go service.
personalization.instructions: Anything else about how to answer
personalization.instructionsPlaceholder: Show code examples in Go. Mention sources at the end.

background.title: Keep running in background
background.description: Closing the window keeps Chat, the API, and your schedules running. This stays on while a schedule exists.

launchAtLogin.title: Launch at login
launchAtLogin.description: Start Toskar automatically when you sign in to this computer.

defaultProfile.title: Default profile
defaultProfile.description: Used when you start a new chat.

runOn.title: Run chats on
runOn.description: Where work should run by default across your team.

lifecycle.title: Model lifecycle
lifecycle.description: Automatic keeps models warm after chat. Manual leaves Start and Stop to you.
lifecycle.idleUnloadHint: Frees memory when a model hasn’t been used for a while. Use 0 to keep models loaded.

downloads.title: Download models
downloads.description: When a profile needs a model that isn’t installed yet.

advanced.title: Advanced mode
advanced.description: Show model IDs, API details, Profiles, logs, and other power-user controls.

discovery.title: Find other computers
discovery.description: Advertise this computer and look for other Toskar installs on your network.
discovery.needsRestart: Networking was updated. Restart Toskar so other computers can fully reach this one.
discovery.restartManually: Quit Toskar completely, then open it again to finish applying network settings.

api.title: API access
api.description: How apps and other devices can talk to Toskar.

notifications.title: Notifications
notifications.description: Alerts for long-running work and team connectivity.
notifications.peerOffline: Notify when a paired computer goes offline

toolPermissions.title: Tool permissions
toolPermissions.description: Default rules for what the AI may do on this computer.

history.title: History
history.description: Control what Toskar keeps on this computer.
history.confirmClear: Delete all chat history on this computer? This cannot be undone.

ratings.title: Community ratings
ratings.description: Rate models with 1 to 5 stars. Your ratings stay on this computer unless you choose to share one when you rate it.
ratings.showHint: Models show how people with similar computers rate them. A public summary is downloaded once a day while you browse models; it sends nothing about you.
ratings.askHint: After you’ve used a model for a while, a chat asks how it’s working.

points.stored: Your chats, memories, knowledge, files, and specialized AIs are stored on this computer, in Toskar's data folder. There's no Toskar account or cloud, and no usage data is sent to anyone.
points.leaves: Something leaves this computer only when you use a feature that goes online, such as a web search, a connected service, or a paired computer. Each time is listed below, under What left this computer.
points.atRest: Toskar doesn't encrypt its own files, and doesn't require you to. To keep them encrypted while the computer is off or locked, turn on its disk encryption: FileVault on macOS, BitLocker on Windows, or LUKS on Linux.
points.inTransit: Websites and online services are reached over encrypted HTTPS connections. Traffic between your own computers, and from other devices on your network to this one, isn't encrypted yet, so use those features only on a network you trust.

whatLeft.title: What left this computer
whatLeft.description: Toskar works on this computer. These are the times a chat, automation, or app sent something elsewhere: web searches and pages, map lookups, paired computers, and connected services. Mark memories or knowledge “This computer only” to keep chats that use them here.
whatLeft.nothing: Nothing left this computer in the last 30 days.
whatLeft.confirmDelete: Delete run records now? This removes stored prompts and tool results from past runs, and this list. Chats are not deleted.
whatLeft.deleted: Deleted {{tasks}} run records, {{automations}} automation results, and {{entries}} entries below.
whatLeft.footnote: Run records hold prompts and tool results from past runs. Chats are kept or not by History below. Each automation keeps its latest result, which “notify when the result changes” compares against.

storage.pending: Will appear when Toskar is running
storage.limitDescription: Soft limit for downloaded models on this computer.

reset.title: Reset application
reset.description: Restore defaults and restart onboarding. Clears chats, custom profiles, tasks, and API keys.
reset.warningKeep: This cannot be undone. You will go through onboarding again. Downloaded models and runtimes will be kept.
reset.warningDelete: This cannot be undone. You will go through onboarding again. Downloaded models will also be deleted.
reset.failed: Could not reset the application. Try again.

external.title: External server
external.description: An OpenAI-compatible server, such as OpenAI, vLLM, or Ollama elsewhere. Its models can be chosen for a chat; Auto never picks them.
external.keyStored: Stored; type a new one to replace it
external.privacy: Chats with these models leave this computer and are recorded in What left this computer. Offline profiles, and chats using memories or knowledge marked This computer only, never use them.
